title: Four day game made for Epics Ai Megajam
author: AdEducational3063
selftext:
I made a post asking if anyone else was involved in the four day megajam. I stayed up three days straight cooking up a concept and a lot of the features that really would have completed the vision didn’t make it to the final demo.

Either way I wanted to share as I love what we have so far. It’s a racing game w local multiplayer and split screen, I created the character and car in midjourney and mapped it to a 3D model.

Because of time restraints we used a lot of pre generated assets for npcs and buildings, I plan to keep working at it over the next few months and make it everything it’s supposed to be.

Here’s the link to check it out please play it and please try to do the multiplayer with one of your friends (must be on same WiFi at this stage, full multiplayer couldn’t fit in the time restraints hopefully I have it running by the end of the month).

100% vibecoded on a MacBook Air M1 with 8 gb or ram for both Mac and windows 

https://fatcentaur.itch.io/bringos-breakbeat
